title: A row gives the source byte of each column
body:
coax maps a selection on screen back to the markdown it came from. `row_sources` in its `src/ui.rs` takes each piece's `Style::source`, the byte its text starts at, and expands it to one byte per character after the row's `lead`, with `None` where cmr drew something of its own.

## Proposal

`Row::sources(&self) -> Vec<Option<usize>>`, one entry per column of the row.
